trans-unit.target: TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2ALPHINAUD_00988_ALPHINAUD_000_000<tab>The Fimm Himnar─the five firmaments... 'Tis sobering to think they are all mankind has left.
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2ALPHINAUD_00988_ALPHINAUD_000_001<tab>There are no other vessels in the sky, much less realmships. It must be rare indeed to encounter those from another collective.

TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2ALPHINAUD_00988_ALPHINAUD_000_100<tab><var 2C ((<var 29 EB02 /var>)) (( )) 02 /var>─do you see the object in the distance? That is apparently the realmship of water, <var 1A 02 /var>Naglfar<var 1A 01 /var>.
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2ALPHINAUD_00988_ALPHINAUD_000_101<tab>In order to evade the jötnar, it is perpetually on the move. That is why the journey takes so long.

TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2ALPHINAUD_00988_ALPHINAUD_000_102<tab>Not only must the crew of <var 1A 02 /var>Glaðr<var 1A 01 /var> be alert for thralls, they must also anticipate the mother ship's ever-changing course. Simply returning home is a trying task.

TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2ALPHINAUD_00988_ALPHINAUD_000_200<tab>At long last, we're close enough to <var 1A 02 /var>Naglfar<var 1A 01 /var> to make out the details. I cannot help but wonder what sights await us there...
TEXT_REGFIM7V6E2ALPHINAUD_00988_ALPHINAUD_000_201<tab>With our comrades duly reassured, we may direct all our attention to the task ahead. Let us be ready when the time comes to disembark!
